fieldValues.title: RFC-051: Per-entry container storage — one file per entry, so concurrent membership edits merge cleanly
fieldValues.author: Peter Brownell (owner request and rulings 1-4, 2026-10-20; accepted 2026-10-20, the-greenman/srs#940)
fieldValues.affected_components:
Container storage under containers/ (each Container a directory of a one-line head and one-line entry files {containerId, instanceId, parent?, key}; memberInstanceIds remains the logical form every adapter presents), the member operations' write sets and the fractional-index key algorithm (mechanism "Container entry order keys"), the three-way merge of a container (per path; replaces RFC-043 [R14]), detached entries (orphans and loops, warnings with a deterministic decode, re-attached by repair), RFC-043 [R1], [R2], [R5], [R6], [R7] and Change D, [R13], [R14], [R18], [R20] (Revision 12), RFC-038 [R5], [R8], [R9], [R13], [R14], [R22], [R23] (Revision 17), Invariant I-21 (amended, effective at revision 11), an editorial pointer in RFC-010 (Draft), the dataModelRevision generation (10 to 11), and a successor record superseding rfc-decision-0df19d60's merge-cost clause. Builds on RFC-052 (revision 10). Landing is two-phase because the data migration lives in the srs-rust migration registry (srs-rust#1414) and the pinned binary cannot load a revision-11 corpus: what lands with acceptance is the RFC text, the Door 3 amendments, the gated invariant and mechanism records, the new key-algorithm mechanism record and the successor decision record. The schema files (stored-container-entry.json, new; container.json, manifest.json, srsj-envelope.json) are staged under docs/schema/staged/rfc-051/ and are promoted with the corpus migration after RFC-052's; the integration manifest therefore names the artifacts folded now and no schema: token.

fieldValues.dependency_refs: Builds on RFC-052 (root container in the container set, Accepted), RFC-043 (ordered container entries, Accepted), RFC-038 (tree-authoritative storage, Accepted) and RFC-046 (revision 9). Supersedes in part rfc-decision-0df19d60 (its merge-cost clause). Coordinates with RFC-010 (Draft). Consults rfc-decision-cce3c00e, rfc-decision-9ee14517, rfc-decision-7caca3a1, rfc-decision-e99a9437, rfc-decision-0750c62f, rfc-decision-0118e938, rfc-decision-4431046e, rfc-decision-628cf6c4, rfc-decision-8948e43f, rfc-decision-2fb87c1e, rfc-decision-86f49083, rfc-decision-5f18603e.
fieldValues.content: Stores each Container as a directory of a one-line head and one one-line file per entry, so two branches that each add a member touch different files and any text merge reaches the result the specification defines. The logical outline and every member operation's behaviour are unchanged; keys come from one shared fractional-indexing algorithm, so one edit always writes the same bytes. Answers SP-30. Full text: rfcs/rfc-051-per-entry-container-storage.md.
